I managed to get one bag of NPK fertilizer from the coupon program this year — my neighbor told me when the agro-dealer arrived in the village. My plot is small, only this quarter hectare, so one bag is what I can carry and use, and I will put it in the planting holes when I sow. I also have goat manure that I will mix into the soil, since the land is mine and I want to keep it good for my children. For seed, I will use the hybrid maize from the same program because my cousin had a good harvest with it last season, but I have no money for chemicals or for hiring workers — I will do all the weeding and harvesting myself with my sister's help.
